page.notes: The left part of the scan is damaged (dark cut-away with wood-grain); no text there. Some inscription lines and the brace entries are uncertain and may be misread. The left-hand brace groups and the "Domus" labels are marginal annotations; the braces are rendered as list structure. Several words are doubtful in the scan, especially in the brace notes and the italic Latin names. Dense damage near the centre (a dark stain over "Ipse Poeta") leaves some words uncertain.
